passive.name: Essence Theft
passive.description: After killing 9 minions or monsters, Ahri heals. After taking down an enemy champion, Ahri heals for a greater amount.

spells.name: Orb of Deception
spells.description: Ahri throws then pulls back her orb, dealing magic damage on the way out and true damage on the way back.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Fox-Fire
spells.description: Ahri releases 3 fox-fires that seek nearby enemies and deal magic damage, reduced to damage beyond the first. She also gains % Move Speed decaying over seconds.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation SingleFireDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Charm
spells.description: Ahri blows a kiss that Charms the first enemy hit for seconds and deals magic damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Spirit Rush
spells.description: Ahri nimbly dashes, firing essence bolts at nearby enemies, prioritizing champions. These bolts deal magic damage each. Spirit Rush can be Recast up to 2 more times within seconds. Consuming a champion's Essence with Essence Theft during this period extends the recast window by up to seconds and grants an additional recast of Spirit Rush (up to stored).
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation RCalculatedDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
